'''Unstable zombie''' is a [[monster]] encountered during [[Ancient Awakening]] and in the standard and hard modes of the [[Ungael combat activity]].

During Ancient Awakening their [[life points]] are reduced to 70% of the value seen in the standard mode of Ungael combat activity. The player fights them with their expedition party in the tower on [[Ungael]], with one of them appearing in the third and sixth waves and two in the tenth and eleventh waves, along with many other monsters.

In the standard mode of the Ungael combat activity three of them appear in the third wave, one in each following wave until seventh, three again in the eighth wave, one in the tenth wave, and two in the eleventh wave, along with many other monsters.

In the hard mode of the Ungael combat activity their life points are increased to 150% of the value seen in the standard mode of Ungael combat activity. One of them appears in the first, second, and third waves, two in fourth, fifth, sixth and seventh, one in the ninth, and two in tenth, eleventh, and twelfth.

It periodically attacks with an area-of-effect attack dealing [[necromancy]] damage. When it is killed, three [[necrotic slime]] appear.
